newsitem.title: USA: Circuit City sees Q1 EPS down 25pct from '96.
newsitem.headline: Circuit City sees Q1 EPS down 25pct from '96.

text.p: Circuit City Stores Inc said Thursday it expects its first quarter earnings per share for its Circuit City group to be down 25 percent from the same quarter a year ago.
The company will release its earnings on June 16, it said.

"Although sales met our expectations for the quarter, the merchandise sales mix and the promotional environment produced gross profit margins below our expectations," Circuit City chairman and chief executive officer Richard Sharp said in a written statement.
The company said comparable-store sales for the first two months of the first quarter were strong than anticipated, led by sales of personal computers.

"That trend changed in May, led by a significant softening in personal computer sales. Cool weather also produced weaker air conditioner sales when compared with last May's strong performance," Sharp said.
Sharp said automobile sales at the company's CarMax Group continue to exceed expectations.
